# Figure 1B

```{r figure-1b}
cluster_sizes <- genome_groups %>%
  count(aa_cluster, name = "cluster_size")

profile_sizes <- genome_groups %>%
  count(profile, name = "profile_size")

AA_based_cluster_isolate_count <- sum(cluster_sizes$cluster_size %>% subset(.>1))
profile_based_cluster_isolate_count <- sum(profile_sizes$profile_size %>% subset(.>1))

multi_cluster_count <- sum(cluster_sizes$cluster_size > 1L)
singleton_count <- n_distinct(genome_groups$aa_cluster)
profile_group_count <- n_distinct(genome_groups$profile)
cluster_profile_count <- sum(profile_sizes$profile_size > 1L)
ics_profile_count <- profile_group_count - cluster_profile_count - singleton_count

workflow_stage_levels <- c("Genomes", "350-AA clusters", "Profiles")
workflow_stratum_levels <- c(
  "Singleton",
  "Outliers",
  "Cluster",
  "Clusters",
  "All genomes"
)
workflow_display_total <- 3257.4 * 1.25 - 500
workflow_stage2_total <- multi_cluster_count + singleton_count
workflow_cluster_share <- 0.95
workflow_singleton_share <- 0.05
workflow_stage2_cluster <- multi_cluster_count
workflow_stage2_singleton <- singleton_count

workflow_stratum_labels <- c(
  "Singletons",
  "Outliers",      
  "Clusters",
  "Profiles (n>1)",   
  "All genomes"
)
workflow_stratum_counts <- c(
  singleton_count,
  ics_profile_count,
  multi_cluster_count,
  cluster_profile_count,
  nrow(genome_groups)
)

workflow_nodes <- tribble(
  ~stage, ~stratum, ~value,
  "Genomes",         "All genomes", workflow_display_total,
  "350-AA clusters", "Cluster",     workflow_stage2_cluster,
  "350-AA clusters", "Singleton",   workflow_stage2_singleton,
  "Profiles",        "Clusters",    cluster_profile_count,
  "Profiles",        "Outliers",     ics_profile_count,
  "Profiles",        "Singleton",   singleton_count
) %>%
  mutate(
    stage   = factor(stage,   levels = workflow_stage_levels),
    stratum = factor(stratum, levels = workflow_stratum_levels)
  )

workflow_flow_12 <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    alluvium = c("Cluster", "Singleton"),
    stage = "Genomes",
    stratum = "All genomes",
    value = workflow_display_total *
      c(workflow_cluster_share, workflow_singleton_share)
  ),
  tibble(
    alluvium = c("Cluster", "Singleton"),
    stage = "350-AA clusters",
    stratum = c("Cluster", "Singleton"),
    value = c(workflow_stage2_cluster, workflow_stage2_singleton)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    stage = factor(stage, levels = workflow_stage_levels),
    stratum = factor(stratum, levels = workflow_stratum_levels)
  )
workflow_flow_23 <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    alluvium = c("Cluster", "Outliers", "Singleton"),
    stage    = "350-AA clusters",
    stratum  = c("Cluster", "Cluster", "Singleton"),
    value    = c(
      workflow_stage2_cluster * cluster_profile_count /
        (cluster_profile_count + ics_profile_count),
      workflow_stage2_cluster * ics_profile_count /
        (cluster_profile_count + ics_profile_count),
      workflow_stage2_singleton
    )
  ),
  tibble(
    alluvium = c("Cluster", "Outliers", "Singleton"),
    stage    = "Profiles",
    stratum  = c("Clusters", "Outliers", "Singleton"),
    value    = c(cluster_profile_count, ics_profile_count, singleton_count)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    stage   = factor(stage,   levels = workflow_stage_levels),
    stratum = factor(stratum, levels = workflow_stratum_levels)
  )

if (
  multi_cluster_count != 823L ||
    singleton_count != 1261L ||
    profile_group_count != 2877L ||
    cluster_profile_count != 1482L ||
    ics_profile_count != 134L
) {
  stop("Cluster and profile workflow counts do not reconcile")
}

workflow_colors <- c(
  "All genomes" = "#636363",
  "Cluster"     = "#2166AC",
  "Clusters"    = "#2166AC",   
  "Singleton"   = "#B2182B",
  "Outliers"     = "#FC8D8D"    
)

p1B <- ggplot() +
    geom_alluvium(
        data = workflow_flow_12,
        aes(
            x = stage,
            stratum = stratum,
            alluvium = alluvium,
            y = value,
            fill = alluvium
        ),
        width = 0.66,
        alpha = 0.62,
        color = NA
    ) +
    geom_alluvium(
        data = workflow_flow_23,
        aes(
            x = stage,
            stratum = stratum,
            alluvium = alluvium,
            y = value,
            fill = alluvium
        ),
        width = 0.66,
        alpha = 0.62,
        color = NA
    ) +
    geom_stratum(
        data = workflow_nodes,
        aes(
            x = stage,
            stratum = stratum,
            y = value,
            fill = after_stat(stratum)
        ),
        width = 0.66,
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_text(
        data = workflow_nodes %>% filter(stage != "Genomes"),
        stat = "stratum",
        aes(
            x = stage,
            stratum = stratum,
            y = value,
            label = case_when(
    as.integer(after_stat(stratum)) %in% c(1L, 2L) ~
        paste0(
            scales::comma(workflow_stratum_counts[as.integer(after_stat(stratum))]),
            " ",
            workflow_stratum_labels[as.integer(after_stat(stratum))]
        ),
    as.integer(after_stat(stratum)) == 3L ~
        paste0(
            scales::comma(multi_cluster_count), " Clusters",
            "\n(n = ", scales::comma(AA_based_cluster_isolate_count), ")"
        ),
    as.integer(after_stat(stratum)) == 4L ~
        paste0(
            scales::comma(cluster_profile_count), " Clusters",
            "\n(n = ", scales::comma(profile_based_cluster_isolate_count), ")"
        ),
    TRUE ~
        paste0(
            workflow_stratum_labels[as.integer(after_stat(stratum))],
            "\n",
            scales::comma(workflow_stratum_counts[as.integer(after_stat(stratum))])
        )
)
        ), 
        size = 2.5,
        lineheight = 0.9,
        color = "white",
    ) +
    annotate(
        "text",
        x = 1,
        y = workflow_display_total / 2,
        label = paste0(nrow(genome_groups),"\ngenomes"),
        color = "white",
        size = 2.5
    ) +
    annotate(
        "text",
        x = c(2, 3),
        y = c(workflow_stage2_total + 175, profile_group_count + 175),
        label = c("AA-based\nclustering", "AA+trait-based\nclustering"),
        color = "black",
        size = 3,
        lineheight = 0.9,
        fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
        limits = c("Genomes", "350-AA clusters", "Profiles"),
        expand = expansion(add = c(0.2, 0.2))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
        values = workflow_colors,
        guide = "none"
    ) + scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
            "All genomes" = "black",
            "Cluster"     = "white",
            "Clusters"    = "white",
            "Singleton"   = "white",
            "Outliers"     = "black"  
        ),
        guide = "none"
    )  +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
        ylim = c(0, workflow_display_total * 1.04),
        clip = "off"
    )
```

# Figure 1D

```{r figure-1c}
ST_size <- ng_STs$ST %>% table %>% as.data.frame %>% `colnames<-`(c("group_id","number_of_genomes")) %>% mutate(group_type = "Sequence type")

group_sizes <- bind_rows(
  cluster_sizes %>%
    transmute(
      group_type = "AA-based\nclustering",
      group_id = aa_cluster,
      number_of_genomes = cluster_size
    ),
  profile_sizes %>%
    transmute(
      group_type = "AA+trait-based\nclustering",
      group_id = profile,
      number_of_genomes = profile_size
    )
) %>% bind_rows(ST_size) %>% 
  mutate(group_type = factor(group_type, levels = c("Sequence type","AA-based\nclustering", "AA+trait-based\nclustering")))

group_size_bin_levels <- c(
  "1",
  "2",
  "3",
  "4",
  "5",
  "6-10",
  "11-15",
  "16-20",
  "21-25",
  "26-50",
  "51-75",
  "76-100",
  "101-250",
  "251-500",
  "501-750",
  "751-1000",
  ">1000"
)

group_size_binned <- group_sizes %>%
  mutate(
    size_bin = cut(
      number_of_genomes,
      breaks = c(
        0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5,
        10, 15, 20, 25,
        50, 75, 100,
        250, 500, 750, 1000,
        Inf
      ),
      labels = group_size_bin_levels,
      right = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  count(group_type, size_bin, .drop = FALSE, name = "number_of_groups") %>%
  group_by(group_type) %>%
  mutate(proportion = number_of_groups / sum(number_of_groups)) %>%
  ungroup()

p1C_base <- ggplot(
  group_size_binned,
  aes(x=size_bin,y= proportion, fill = group_type)
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.82),
    width = 0.76,
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Sequence type" ="brown","AA-based\nclustering" = "darkgray", "AA+trait-based\nclustering" = "black"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      keywidth = grid::unit(0.30, "cm"),
      keyheight = grid::unit(0.30, "cm")
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = "Genomes per group", y = "Proportion of groups") +
  theme_figure +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7.5),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = c(0.98, 0.98),
    legend.justification = c(1, 1),
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = alpha("white", 0.88),
      color = "grey70",
      linewidth = 0.25
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.margin = margin(2, 3, 2, 3)
  )

p1C_upper <- p1C_base +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0.30, 0.40, 0.50),
    labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 0, 5)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.30, 0.52), clip = "on")

p1C_lower <- p1C_base +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15),
    labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 5, 5)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.15), clip = "on")

p1C_core <- plot_grid(
  p1C_upper,
  NULL,
  p1C_lower,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(0.6, 0.108, 1.7),
  align = "v",
  axis = "lr"
)

p1C <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(
    p1C_core,
    x = 0.045,
    y = 0,
    width = 0.955,
    height = 1
  ) 
```

# Figure #

```{r figure-1d}
st_representation <- genome_groups %>%
  count(ST, st_class, name = "original_n") %>%
  left_join(
    genome_groups %>%
      filter(selected) %>%
      count(ST, name = "selected_n"),
    by = "ST"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    selected_n = replace_na(selected_n, 0L),
    original_proportion = original_n / sum(original_n),
    selected_proportion = selected_n / sum(selected_n),
    change_percentage_points = 100 * (selected_proportion - original_proportion)
  )

st_class_colors <- c("Major ST" = "#D73027", "Minor ST" = "#2166AC")

ST_scale <-  scale_fill_manual(
    values = st_class_colors,
    breaks = c("Major ST", "Minor ST"),
    labels = c("Major (n >= 100)","Minor"),
    name = "Sequence type category"
  ) 

p1D_base <- ggplot(
  st_representation %>%
    mutate(
      st_class = factor(st_class, levels = c("Major ST", "Minor ST"))
    ),
  aes(change_percentage_points, fill = st_class)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 40,
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.18
  ) + ST_scale +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_number(accuracy = 1, suffix = "%")) +
  labs(
    x = "Change in sequence type representation\n(selected - overall)",
    y = "Sequence types"
  ) +
  theme_figure +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

st_histogram_max <- max(ggplot_build(p1D_base)$data[[1]]$count)
st_histogram_upper_min <- 100

p1D_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(
  p1D_base +
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(
        nrow = 1,
        byrow = TRUE,
        keywidth = grid::unit(0.30, "cm"),
        keyheight = grid::unit(0.30, "cm")
      )
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(2, "pt"),
      legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
    )
)

p1D_upper <- p1D_base +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(
      st_histogram_upper_min,
      ceiling(st_histogram_max / 50) * 50
    ),
    labels = comma
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 0, 5)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(st_histogram_upper_min, st_histogram_max * 1.05),
    clip = "on"
  )

p1D_lower <- p1D_base +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25),
    labels = comma,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11, margin = margin(r = 10)),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 5, 5)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 25), clip = "on")

p1D <- plot_grid(
  p1D_upper,
  NULL,
  p1D_lower,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(0.15, 0.07, 1),
  align = "v",
  axis = "lr"
) 
```

# Figure 1G

```{r figure-1G}
phenotype_vars <- names(profiles_350)[1:8]
genotype_vars <- names(profiles_350)[9:30]

phenotype_change <- map_dfr(
  phenotype_vars,
  function(variable) {
    present <- profiles_350[[variable]] == "RESISTANT"
    tibble(
      trait = paste(variable, "resistant"),
      trait_type = "Phenotype",
      original_proportion = weighted.mean(present, profiles_350$count),
      selected_proportion = mean(present)
    )
  }
)

genotype_change <- map_dfr(
  genotype_vars,
  function(variable) {
    present <- as.integer(as.character(profiles_350[[variable]]))
    tibble(
      trait = str_replace_all(variable, "_", " "),
      trait_type = "Genotype",
      original_proportion = weighted.mean(present, profiles_350$count),
      selected_proportion = mean(present)
    )
  }
) %>% mutate(trait = paste0("<i>",trait,"</i>") %>% gsub("<i>blaTEM</i>","<i>bla</i><sub>TEM</sub>",.))

trait_representation <- bind_rows(phenotype_change, genotype_change) %>%
  mutate(
    change_percentage_points = 100 * (selected_proportion - original_proportion),
    trait_type = factor(trait_type, levels = c("Phenotype", "Genotype")),
    trait = fct_reorder(trait, change_percentage_points)
  ) 


trait_type_colors <- c("Phenotype" = "#D95F02", "Genotype" = "#2166AC")

p1F <- ggplot(
  trait_representation,
  aes(change_percentage_points, trait,color=trait_type)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 0, xend = change_percentage_points, yend = trait),
    color = "grey70",
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(trait_type),
    scales = "free_y",
    space = "free_y",
    labeller = labeller(
      trait_type = c(
        "Phenotype" = "Resistance",
        "Genotype" = "Genotype"
      )
    )
  )  + 
  scale_color_manual(values = trait_type_colors, guide = "none") + 
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_number(accuracy = 1, suffix = "%")) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub(" resistant$", "", x)) +
  labs(
    x = "Change in representation\n(selected - overall)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_figure +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9.5),
    axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = 6.75),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )
```

  "scripts/figures/NG_1A_concept_fig.png"
))

figure_1_new_a <- ggdraw() +
  draw_grob(
    grid::rasterGrob(concept_1a_raster, interpolate = TRUE),

# ranking STs in size range for example that shows multiple 350-AA clusters being partitioned into both singleton and multi-genome profiles of different sizes
find_profile_example_sts <- function(
  data,
  min_genomes = 50,
  max_genomes = 60
) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(ST)) %>%
    count(ST, aa_cluster, profile, name = "profile_size") %>%
    group_by(ST) %>%
    summarise(
      n_genomes = sum(profile_size),
      n_clusters = n_distinct(aa_cluster),
      n_profiles = n(),
      singleton_profiles = sum(profile_size == 1),
      multi_genome_profiles = sum(profile_size > 1),
      split_clusters = sum(table(aa_cluster) > 1),
      distinct_profile_sizes = n_distinct(profile_size),
      max_profile_size = max(profile_size),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      between(n_genomes, min_genomes, max_genomes),
      singleton_profiles > 0,
      multi_genome_profiles > 0,
      split_clusters > 0
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(split_clusters),
      desc(distinct_profile_sizes),
      desc(n_profiles),
      abs(n_genomes - mean(c(min_genomes, max_genomes))),
      ST
    )
}

example_st_candidates <- find_profile_example_sts(genome_groups)
if (nrow(example_st_candidates) == 0) {
  stop("No ST satisfies the requested example criteria")
}
example_st_summary <- slice_head(example_st_candidates, n = 1)
example_st <- example_st_summary$ST

example_st_data <- genome_groups %>%
  filter(ST == example_st)

example_st_tree <- keep.tip(tree, example_st_data$genome_id)

example_cluster_lookup <- example_st_data %>%
  distinct(aa_cluster) %>%
  arrange(readr::parse_number(aa_cluster), aa_cluster) %>%
  mutate(cluster_number = row_number())

example_profile_lookup <- example_st_data %>%
  distinct(aa_cluster, profile) %>%
  left_join(example_cluster_lookup, by = "aa_cluster") %>%
  arrange(cluster_number, readr::parse_number(profile), profile) %>%
  group_by(aa_cluster) %>%
  mutate(profile_number = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(profile_label = paste0(cluster_number, ".", profile_number))

# Map profile-level resistance calls back to every genome in the example ST
# Only traits with more than one observed state in this subset are kept
profile_trait_values <- profiles_350 %>%
  transmute(
    profile = as.character(cl_prof_id),
    across(
      all_of(phenotype_vars),
      as.character
    ),
    across(
      all_of(genotype_vars),
      ~ as.integer(as.character(.x))
    )
  )

example_st_plot_data <- example_st_data[
  match(example_st_tree$tip.label, example_st_data$genome_id),
] %>%
  left_join(example_cluster_lookup, by = "aa_cluster") %>%
  left_join(
    example_profile_lookup %>%
      select(aa_cluster, profile, profile_number, profile_label),
    by = c("aa_cluster", "profile")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    profile_trait_values,
    by = "profile"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_track = paste0("Cluster ", cluster_number),
    profile_track = paste0("Profile ", profile_label)
  )

example_cluster_levels <- paste0(
  "Cluster ",
  seq_len(max(example_st_plot_data$cluster_number))
)
example_profile_levels <- example_profile_lookup %>%
  arrange(cluster_number, profile_number) %>%
  transmute(level = paste0("Profile ", profile_label)) %>%
  pull(level)
example_profile_labels <- sub("^Profile ", "", example_profile_levels)

example_variable_phenotypes <- phenotype_vars[
  vapply(
    example_st_plot_data[phenotype_vars],
    function(x) n_distinct(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 1,
    logical(1)
  )
]
example_variable_genotypes <- genotype_vars[
  vapply(
    example_st_plot_data[genotype_vars],
    function(x) n_distinct(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 1,
    logical(1)
  )
]

example_st_tracks <- example_st_plot_data %>%
  transmute(
    Cluster = factor(cluster_track, levels = example_cluster_levels),
    Profile = factor(profile_track, levels = example_profile_levels)
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

for (variable in example_variable_phenotypes) {
  example_st_tracks[[variable]] <- factor(
    case_when(
      example_st_plot_data[[variable]] == "RESISTANT" ~ "RESISTANT",
      example_st_plot_data[[variable]] == "INTERMEDIATE" ~ "INTERMEDIATE",
      example_st_plot_data[[variable]] %in% c("NOT_FOUND", "SUSCEPTIBLE") ~
        "NOT_FOUND",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    levels = resistance_levels
  )
}
for (variable in example_variable_genotypes) {
  example_st_tracks[[variable]] <- factor(
    if_else(
      example_st_plot_data[[variable]] == 1,
      "Genotype present",
      "Genotype absent",
      missing = NA_character_
    ),
    levels = c("Genotype absent", "Genotype present")
  )
}
rownames(example_st_tracks) <- example_st_plot_data$genome_id

example_st_selection <- example_st_plot_data %>%

# cluster and profile colors for set example

)
example_profile_colors <- setNames(
